description: This bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for two multilingual BERT models, mBERT and XLM-R, across seven distinct linguistic categories labeled on the horizontal axis: L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺. The vertical axis represents the Shapley value, scaled linearly from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The chart employs grouped bars, with each category on the x-axis containing two bars: a light blue bar representing mBERT and a dark blue bar representing XLM-R. The legend confirms this color coding. For most categories, the values are low, with the exception of the category labeled 'T', where both models exhibit significantly higher Shapley values, approximately 60 for mBERT and 55 for XLM-R. The tallest bar overall is the light green one associated with 'T', which corresponds to a value of approximately 80; however, this bar is not labeled in the legend and appears to be a third model or a different representation not explicitly identified. The bars are not sorted by value; they are presented in the order of the linguistic categories from left to right. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
